content.text:
=== direct frontend ===
frontend:3002 /app/ -> 200
=== keycloak token exit ===
token-http:200
"token_type":"Bearer"
=== override file ===
# Local override: the upstream `minio/minio` and `minio/mc` Docker Hub repositories are no
# longer publicly pullable, so substitute the Bitnami MinIO images (same CLI/env contract).
services:
  minio:
    image: bitnamilegacy/minio:latest
    user: "0"
  minio-init:
    image: bitnamilegacy/minio-client:latest

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== direct frontend ==="; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "frontend:3002 /app/ -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3002/app/; echo "=== keycloak token exit ==="; SECRET=$(grep '^LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET=' .env | cut -d= -f2); curl -s -m 15 -X POST "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=local-client&client_secret=$SECRET&username=spark@example.com&password=SparkLocal123!" -o /tmp/tok.json -w "token-http:%{http_code}\n"; grep -o '"token_type":"[^"]*"' /tmp/tok.json; echo "=== override file ==="; cat docker-compose.override.yaml
